verdict.rationale: Sentry's docs carry a 'Data Storage Location (US or EU)' heading, which points to a first-party region choice for hosted data. Its official self-hosted distribution also lets users run all of Sentry on their own servers and so keep data wherever they host it. The region-selection evidence is only a bare heading (attached to an unrelated Slack-integration URL), so the depth of the feature is unproven. Missing for 10: documented details of how and when a region is chosen (e.g. at org creation, migration between regions), any regions beyond US/EU, plan availability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: How you can run all of Sentry on your own server, without paying anything.
